summary: Framing of charge under Section 307 IPC for attempted murder; nature of injury irrelevant for attempt to murder; overt act with specific intent required; throttling causing potential respiratory arrest satisfies attempt; charge framing permissible based on intent and actions; High Court's rejection of charge set aside; retrial ordered.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; case remanded for framing charge under Section 307 IPC; respondents to face trial.
